name: infisical-secret-add
summary: Store one new secret in an Infisical project from a hidden terminal prompt, then verify it by in-memory read-back without exposing the value.
triggers: add this API key to Infisical
store a new key in Infisical
save a secret to Infisical without pasting it in chat
get the terminal ready so I can paste the key
side_effects: writes one named secret to the chosen Infisical project, environment and folder
replaces an existing value only with explicit --overwrite
